title: Pay too much for coffee
description: Pay more than $8 for a coffee

title: Look for a sharehouse
description: Go to an open home for a rental property.
rule1: The home must have at least two bedrooms

title: Tim tam slam
description: Successfully drink hot chocolate through a tim tam.

title: Look for Harold
description:
Spend ten minutes looking for Harold Holt in the ocean.
If you find him, you immediately win the game.
rule1: You must have a clear view of the ocean
rule2: You can be any distance from the ocean

title: Cross the same river twice
description:
Cross a river twice.
You must cross the river at two different points, using two different methods of transport
rule1: You must start and end in the neighbourhood you are claiming
rule2: You may temporarily leave the neighbourhood during this challenge
rule3: The river must have a name
rule4: Acceptable methods are: walking, cycling, tram, train, bus, or boat

title: See a goal
description: Watch someone score an AFL goal
rule1: The goal must be scored with real AFL goals by a real AFL ball

title: Sing happy birthday to a tree
description:
Visit a tree which was planted on today's date.
Sing happy birthday to the tree.

title: Predict the train doors
description:
Stand at the place where the train doors will open.
If any part of the train entryway is directly in front of your eyeline when the doors open, you succeed.
rule1: Only one team member may attempt this challenge at a time
rule2: You may keep attempting this challenge with new trains

title: Rhino on a skateboard
description: Put a Rhino on a skateboard. Make the rhino roll one meter without anyone touching or propelling it.
rule1: The Rhino must be a clear depiction of a rhino.
rule2: The skateboard must be something with wheels
rule3: You may not make your own rhino or skateboard

title: Complete a Trainle
description: Complete a Trainle in 6 guesses or less.
rule1: You may not use your phone to look at train stations

title: Go one kilometre
description:
One team member must pick a random direction by spinning around with eyes closed.
Find the point exactly 1km in that direction using google maps.
Go to within 10 metres of that point.
rule1: If the point is legally or physically inaccessible, spin again
rule2: Claim the neighbourhood where you began the challenge, even if you leave it to complete the challenge.

title: Try tricky train track trials
description:
Go to a metro station that has the same first letter as the first name of someone in your team.
Describe the metro station using three adjectives which start with the same letter.
rule1: You must use the team member's most commonly used name

title: Report a pothole
description: Complete a pothole report using the official Montreal pothole reporting website.

title: Visit every Tim Hortons
description:
Visit every open Tim Hortons in this neighbourhood. 
You must go into the Tim Hortons. 
If there are no Tim Hortons in the neighbourhood, draw a new challenge and return this one to the deck.
